profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Northrop Grumman | MEng in Systems Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed geospatial services within a VPC in an S2P environment, enhancing product processing.  
• Interfaced with AWS services including SQS, SNS, S3, and CloudWatch to optimize application performance.  
• Ported and refactored legacy algorithms to customer cloud , improving code maintainability.  
• Created Jenkins builds for nightly releases, ensuring consistent product availability on a Nexus repository.
positions.insights: C, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +16 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed software focused on modeling and multi-step data/imagery processing for complex processing chains.  
• Collaborated with the embedded team to define file formats and header structures for data processing.  
• Built automation scripts that significantly reduced manual downloading and organizing of hundreds of products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Key contributor to a mission-critical software system for the US Government, ensuring 24x7x365 operational reliability.  
• Developed and enhanced software using GWT, C, C++, and Java, driving innovation and efficiency.  
• Supported the promotion of update releases through on-site travel, facilitating smooth operational transitions.

volunteerExperiences.description: Help secure grants for the last four FIRST seasons  totaling over ten thousand dollars to benefit Brevard Public School children.  Mentor and help coach several teams from elementary to middle school age
